lunch_start.name: {name}
lunch_start.text: *As the lunch bell rings, the classroom stirs. Seoyeon picks up her lunch bag and heads for the stairs. Dain waves from the hallway. Yuna holds the book to her chest and starts toward the library.*

lunch_start_4.name: Seoyeon
lunch_start_4.text: You're coming up to the rooftop, like I said, right? *She stops on the landing and points upstairs with her fingertip.*

lunch_start_4_b.name: {name}
lunch_start_4_b.text: *Just as I go to answer, Dain comes up beside me, and her warm palm snatches my wrist.*

lunch_start_5.name: Dain
lunch_start_5.text: Hey, you haven't had lunch yet, right? Let's run to the snack bar. We'll bet on bread. Loser buys lunch today!

lunch_start_6.name: Yuna
lunch_start_6.text: I'm going to the library. *As she brushes past me, she shortens her grip on the bag strap.*

lunch_start_7.name: {name}
lunch_start_7.text: *Three paths sit in front of me: the windy rooftop, the snack bar that smells of sweet bread, and the quiet library.*

lunch_choice.name: {name}
lunch_choice.text: *Lunch on the first day. Whose footsteps do I follow?*
choices: Go to the school store with Dain

lunch_seo_1.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_1.text: *Clack. The moment Seoyeon opens the heavy iron door with a small key, a crisp April breeze rushes in and brushes the front of my hair.*

lunch_seo_1_aff_high.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_1_aff_high.text: Come sit over here. That joke you made in the hallway this morning stayed with me all through class. It was kind of funny.

lunch_seo_1_aff_default.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_1_aff_default.text: Don't just stand there. Come sit over here.

lunch_seo_2.name: {name}
lunch_seo_2.text: You take care of all the pots in the corner of the rooftop, too? *Two folding chairs sit side by side under the shade next to the potted plant.*

lunch_seo_3.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_3.text: Yeah. No one else comes up. This is my own place to rest.

lunch_seo_4.name: {name}
lunch_seo_4.text: The whole school rooftop to yourself. Student council president privilege is pretty impressive.

lunch_seo_5.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_5.text: I never open this place to anyone else. *She unfolds a folding chair without a sound.* I'm only making an exception for today.

lunch_seo_6.name: {name}
lunch_seo_6.text: Special treatment on my first day transferring. What are you planning to make me do later?

lunch_seo_6_b.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_6_b.text: *With the toe of her shoe, she nudges a chair leg to set the gap.* Don't be so suspicious. Downstairs is noisy, and it's quiet here. That's why I brought you.

lunch_seo_8.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_8.text: *From the bag on her lap, she sets out two pastel lunch boxes side by side, easily enough for 2.*

lunch_seo_9.name: {name}
lunch_seo_9.text: Hold on. However I look at this, it's for 2.

lunch_seo_10.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_10.text: When student council meetings run long, I often can't eat on time. I usually pack a little extra.

lunch_seo_11.name: {name}
lunch_seo_11.text: Golden rolled omelet, octopus-shaped sausages, rice balls. Perfect. And two sets of chopsticks from the start.

lunch_seo_13.name: {name}
lunch_seo_13.text: Don't tell me you made this yourself this morning.

lunch_seo_14.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_14.text: If the student council president can't even pack her own lunch, I lose face.

lunch_seo_15.name: {name}
lunch_seo_15.text: Forget the face talk. I asked if you packed a share for me on purpose.

lunch_seo_16.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_16.text: *Instead of answering, she presses wooden chopsticks into my hand and looks away.* Quit prying and eat. It won't taste good once it gets cold.

lunch_seo_17.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_17.text: Then I'll taste it first. *Beyond the railing, the sunlit field and the quiet roof of the library annex are all in view.*

lunch_seo_19.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_19.text: You've been here all morning. How's our school?

lunch_seo_20.name: {name}
lunch_seo_20.text: For now, the lunch box is really good.

lunch_seo_21.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_21.text: *Seoyeon laughs as she touches the lunch box divider with her chopsticks.* I asked what you thought of the school. Why is the answer praise for the lunch box?

lunch_seo_22.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_22.text: *Seoyeon hesitates a moment, then picks the best-shaped piece of rolled omelet and carefully holds it out in front of my mouth.*

lunch_seo_23.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_23.text: Here, try this too. I'm only giving you one bite.

lunch_seo_choice.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_choice.text: *The yellow rolled omelet on the tip of her chopsticks stops a handspan from my lips.*
choices: It'd taste better if you ate it yourself
You went to all that trouble, so I’ll have just one bite.
At this rate, I could ask you to make me lunch from now on.

lunch_seo_c1_1.name: {name}
lunch_seo_c1_1.text: *I lean in a little and eat the fluffy, warm rolled omelet right off the chopsticks Seoyeon holds out.*

lunch_seo_c1_2.name: {name}
lunch_seo_c1_2.text: It's really good. The seasoning is just right.

lunch_seo_c1_2_b.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_c1_2_b.text: Don't swallow it in a rush. Chew slower. *The plastic label crinkles in Seoyeon's hand as she hides her mouth behind the water bottle.*

lunch_seo_c1_3.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_c1_3.text: I made it. Of course it tastes at least that good.

lunch_seo_c1_3_b.name: {name}
lunch_seo_c1_3_b.text: *Still fiddling with the half-folded label on the water bottle, Seoyeon hides her flushed earlobe and picks up her chopsticks again.*

lunch_seo_c2_1.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_c2_1.text: Yeah? Then this one's mine. *She puts the rolled omelet in her mouth and taps the corner of the lunch-box lid with her chopsticks.*

lunch_seo_c2_2.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_c2_2.text: Mm. Like you said, it's good when I eat it too.

lunch_seo_c2_3.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_c2_3.text: Hold on. Why won't the lid line up. *Her hands rush, and only on the third try does the lid click shut.*

lunch_seo_after.name: {name}
lunch_seo_after.text: *On the wind, the sound of a ball being kicked and kids laughing drifts faintly up from the field.*

lunch_seo_after_2.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_after_2.text: Tomorrow at lunch, don't make other plans. Keep it open.

lunch_seo_after_3.name: {name}
lunch_seo_after_3.text: You're inviting me to the president's private rooftop again tomorrow?

lunch_seo_after_4.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_after_4.text: It's not some grand invitation. I just mean let's eat together. Come straight up when the bell rings.

lunch_seo_after_5.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_after_5.text: *She ties the lunch-cloth knot neatly in her hands and glances up at me.*

lunch_seo_freetalk.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_freetalk.text: *She puts the lunch box in her bag, nudges the folding chair about half a handspan toward me, and sits.* The breeze up here is pretty cool. You're not cold, are you?
lunch_seo_freetalk.context: First-day lunch. Just after sharing Seoyeon's bento on the rooftop. They are still awkward, but starting to be curious about each other.
lunch_seo_freetalk.personality: Seoyeon is a composed student council president with a deliberate pace. She observes before showing interest and is honest in both speech and action.

lunch_dain_1.name: Dain
lunch_dain_1.text: Whew, got here first! This is our school's snack bar. Let's pick before the line gets long.

lunch_dain_1_aff_default.name: Dain
lunch_dain_1_aff_default.text: The smell of fresh bread is no joke, right? It's a little crowded, but this place is the best. *She grabs my sleeve and strides into the snack bar.*

lunch_dain_2.name: Dain
lunch_dain_2.text: Crispy soboro bread and cold strawberry milk! This combo never lets me down, no matter when I get it.

lunch_dain_3.name: {name}
lunch_dain_3.text: But you said the loser buys the bread. What are we betting with?

lunch_dain_4.name: Dain
lunch_dain_4.text: Rock-paper-scissors, one round. Obviously. Nice and clean!

lunch_dain_5.name: {name}
lunch_dain_5.text: First person I've seen who bets their life on rock-paper-scissors.

lunch_dain_6.name: Dain
lunch_dain_6.text: Get scared and back out now, and that counts as you buying.

lunch_dain_7.name: {name}
lunch_dain_7.text: Who's backing out? Come at me.

lunch_dain_8.name: {name}
lunch_dain_8.text: *I face Dain, close my fist, and steady my breath.*

lunch_dain_9.name: Dain
lunch_dain_9.text: If you don't throw, you lose! Rock, paper, scissors!

lunch_dain_10.name: {name}
lunch_dain_10.text: *Dain's wide-open scissors stop in front of my fist. Dain loses.*

lunch_dain_11.name: Dain
lunch_dain_11.text: Whoa, I lost? Hold on. You know it's best of three, right? One more round!

lunch_dain_12.name: {name}
lunch_dain_12.text: Remind me who just yelled that it was one round.

lunch_dain_12_b.name: Dain
lunch_dain_12_b.text: Ugh, you're really annoying! Fine, I'll buy, fair and square! Ma'am, two soboro breads and a strawberry milk, please!

lunch_dain_14.name: Dain
lunch_dain_14.text: *She sets the coins down lightly on the counter and hugs two bags of warm soboro bread to her chest.*

lunch_dain_15.name: {name}
lunch_dain_15.text: *We sit side by side on a bench in the wisteria's shade and share the bags of bread. Each time Dain moves, her warmth reaches me, carrying the scent of sunshine.*

lunch_dain_16.name: Dain
lunch_dain_16.text: *She rips the bread bag open cleanly and stares straight at me.* Hey, do you seriously not do any sports at all?

lunch_dain_17.name: {name}
lunch_dain_17.text: Why, worried I'll get tired right away?

lunch_dain_18.name: Dain
lunch_dain_18.text: Worried? Please. If you're going to stick with me, I need to see if your basic stamina even passes.

lunch_dain_19.name: {name}
lunch_dain_19.text: I thought you were sneaking in a little PR.

lunch_dain_20.name: Dain
lunch_dain_20.text: PR? You mean my publicity, or a personal record?

lunch_dain_21.name: {name}
lunch_dain_21.text: Publicity, this time. You're looking for a partner with the stamina to run around beside you.

lunch_dain_22.name: Dain
lunch_dain_22.text: *The corner of the pink strawberry milk carton in Dain's hand crumples a little.*

lunch_dain_23.name: Dain
lunch_dain_23.text: Ahem. Caught in one shot. So, do you actually have any feel for sports?

lunch_dain_choice.name: Dain
lunch_dain_choice.text: *Straw in her mouth, Dain looks into my eyes and leans in until our shoulders almost touch.*
choices: A little. Would you teach me?
I was just going along with it.

lunch_dain_c1_1.name: Dain
lunch_dain_c1_1.text: Oh, so you're confident? Then come to the gym after school today. I'll check your warm-up myself. Deal?

lunch_dain_c1_2.name: Dain
lunch_dain_c1_2.text: Hey, I'm already looking forward to this! *She laughs, excited, and springs up off the bench.*

lunch_dain_c2_1.name: Dain
lunch_dain_c2_1.text: Come on, it's not like you have zero interest! Drop by the gym for a bit after school today. Even just watching should be fun.

lunch_dain_after.name: {name}
lunch_dain_after.text: *I brush off the leftover crumbs and start to get up, and Dain steps in front of me.*

lunch_dain_after_4.name: Dain
lunch_dain_after_4.text: I'm the first friend you've eaten with since transferring to this school? This is a historic day.

lunch_dain_after_5.name: Dain
lunch_dain_after_5.text: *She taps my shoulder with a playful fist, then steps back a pace, leaving the warmth of her springy fingertips.*

lunch_dain_freetalk.name: Dain
lunch_dain_freetalk.text: *She folds the empty bread bag small, stuffs it in her pocket, and drapes an arm over the back of the bench.* So, transfer student! What's your score for our school's first snack-bar tour?
lunch_dain_freetalk.context: First-day lunch, just after a rock-paper-scissors bet with Dain at the school store. She lost and bought the bread. They have only begun getting to know each other.
lunch_dain_freetalk.personality: Dain is an energetic volleyball player who often acts before she overthinks. She is candid and quick to respond, with competitiveness and kindness both part of her character.

lunch_yuna_1.name: {name}
lunch_yuna_1.text: *I pass the stairs where the hallway noise falls away and follow Yuna into the cool, quiet library.*

lunch_yuna_1_aff_default.name: Yuna
lunch_yuna_1_aff_default.text: *There was no note handed over. Yuna is already sitting in a corner of the reading room, where the sunlight falls at a slant, quietly opening a book.*

lunch_yuna_2.name: Yuna
lunch_yuna_2.text: Pull the chair in quietly. Easy. *With a pale index finger, she quietly presses the corner of the open page.*

lunch_yuna_4.name: Yuna
lunch_yuna_4.text: Wait a moment. *She folds the end of the loan receipt she had tucked in, neat and straight, and hides it under the bookmark.*

lunch_yuna_5.name: {name}
lunch_yuna_5.text: *5 seconds, then another 10, pass in quiet. Yuna only touches the folded corner of the receipt. She doesn't turn a page.*

lunch_yuna_5_b.name: {name}
lunch_yuna_5_b.text: If the seat next to you is empty, can I sit?

lunch_yuna_7.name: Yuna
lunch_yuna_7.text: *Without taking her eyes off the print, she whispers, low.* As long as you don't make a fuss beside me.

lunch_yuna_8.name: Yuna
lunch_yuna_8.text: I moved my bag. Sit here. *She clears her bag off the chair beside her, then drops her eyes back to the book.*

lunch_yuna_10.name: {name}
lunch_yuna_10.text: *Over the desks where we sit side by side, only the wall clock's second hand and the brush of paper overlap, faint.*

lunch_yuna_10_b.name: {name}
lunch_yuna_10_b.text: *Yuna's fingertips cover the faded writing on the bookmark. I look away and pull a book from the shelf behind us.*

lunch_yuna_12.name: Yuna
lunch_yuna_12.text: *Over her book, Yuna's eyes rise slowly, a faint red in them.* The one you just took out. That's volume 3.

lunch_yuna_14.name: Yuna
lunch_yuna_14.text: That series only makes sense if you read it in order, from volume 1.

lunch_yuna_15.name: Yuna
lunch_yuna_15.text: Here. Read this one first. *She slides volume 1, the one she'd stacked by her hand, over toward me.*

lunch_yuna_16.name: {name}
lunch_yuna_16.text: You're lending it to me? Thanks.

lunch_yuna_17.name: Yuna
lunch_yuna_17.text: When you're done, give it back to me.

lunch_yuna_18.name: Yuna
lunch_yuna_18.text: Then let's each read on our own. *With one desk between us, we open the first page side by side.*

lunch_yuna_20.name: {name}
lunch_yuna_20.text: *When I look up after a long while, Yuna, the window light at her back, is quietly looking at my face over her book.*

lunch_yuna_21.name: {name}
lunch_yuna_21.text: What's wrong? Something you want to say to me?

lunch_yuna_22.name: Yuna
lunch_yuna_22.text: *Yuna slips a thin bookmark in between the pages.* Just, for staying quiet the whole time.

lunch_yuna_24.name: Yuna
lunch_yuna_24.text: It was more comfortable than I expected.

lunch_yuna_25.name: Yuna
lunch_yuna_25.text: *Yuna's gaze skims the cover of the book in my hand and meets my eyes. In a brief silence, her cool, deep gaze tangles with mine.*

lunch_yuna_choice.name: {name}
lunch_yuna_choice.text: *I slowly close the book I was reading and meet Yuna's eyes.*
choices: I’d like to read the rest.
I guess you like sitting quietly with a book.
I’ll keep you more entertained than that book.
We could be comfortable together without having to talk.

lunch_yuna_c1_1.name: Yuna
lunch_yuna_c1_1.text: Yeah. Don't rush through it. Start from volume 1 and read it slowly. It gets a lot deeper the further you go.

lunch_yuna_c1_2.name: Yuna
lunch_yuna_c1_2.text: When you've read all the way to the last page, tell me. I want to know how you read it.

lunch_yuna_c2_1.name: Yuna
lunch_yuna_c2_1.text: There's nothing to do if I stay in the classroom anyway.

lunch_yuna_c2_2.name: Yuna
lunch_yuna_c2_2.text: I do like this corner seat, though. Nobody comes looking for me.

lunch_yuna_freetalk.name: Yuna
lunch_yuna_freetalk.text: *Yuna quietly lays her two pale hands, one over the other, on the cover of the closed book.* Spending time this quietly... you weren't bored?
lunch_yuna_freetalk.context: First-day lunch, just after spending a quiet stretch of time with Yuna in the library. They do not know each other well yet, but there is a quiet curiosity between them.
lunch_yuna_freetalk.personality: Yuna is a reserved and cautious reader. She tends to observe and think before speaking, revealing more of her own thoughts as trust develops.

lunch_end.name: {name}
lunch_end.text: *The chime announcing period 5 rings out, and the short, fluttering first lunch comes to an end.*

lunch_dain_trap_1.name: Dain
lunch_dain_trap_1.text: Hey, if you're not interested, just say so. Forcing yourself to play along is what I hate most.

lunch_seo_1_aff_neg.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_1_aff_neg.text: *She clutches the clipboard tight to her chest and looks only past the rooftop railing.* I have to look over student council papers right now, so I'm busy. If you don't need anything, go back down.

lunch_seo_neg_leave.name: {name}
lunch_seo_neg_leave.text: *I leave the coldly shut iron door of the rooftop behind me and go down the heavy stairs.*

lunch_dain_1_aff_neg.name: Dain
lunch_dain_1_aff_neg.text: *She keeps a step's distance in the checkout line and looks only ahead.* I'm not in the mood for a bread bet today. Buy yours quick and go.

lunch_dain_neg_leave.name: {name}
lunch_dain_neg_leave.text: *I quietly slip out of the noisy snack-shop line and stand alone in the hallway.*

lunch_yuna_1_aff_neg.name: Yuna
lunch_yuna_1_aff_neg.text: *She doesn't so much as look up from the open book.* I want to be alone today. Go sit somewhere else.

lunch_yuna_neg_leave.name: {name}
lunch_yuna_neg_leave.text: *I close the door of the quiet reading room and hush my footsteps as I go down the stairs.*
